description: A represented application at a tuple consists of an application retained in subterm-closed \(S\) whose argument classes are exactly the given tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.ApplicationWitness.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.SubtermClosed S) {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n)
  (xs : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S E hE) : Type u
